bundle.name: Coldwell Silo woodland compound

surface.scope: Surface component only; reserved void cells require the companion.

bundle.status: Candidate preserving handoff. Farmyard owner must adopt and confirm the import seam; not a currently supported standalone Farmyard operation.
bundle.unsupportedPolicy: Reject before play if required geometry/providers cannot load. Keep every source file; do not drop underground floors, cut polygons, trees, fencing or roofs.

inventory.accessPortal: Retained in the required silo companion

coordinates.formula: Legacy preview (X,Y,Z)=(native X+38,native Y,native Z+85). Nonnegative world (x,y,h)=(preview X+.5,preview Z+.5,preview Y+46.64). Apply the common half-metre horizontal and 46.64 m vertical offsets exactly once to surface, silo and anchors.

companion.geometry: Original annular walls, clipped floor polygons, actual openings and independent art rigs. Envelope AABBs are not exact collision.
companion.registration: The artist-prefixed capabilities are intake requirements, not registered engine/game features.
companion.acceptance: Reject the complete bundle before play if any required companion/provider is unsupported. Never present surface-only loading as the whole silo.

plan.name: Coldwell Silo
plan.source: Titan II museum architectural arrangement; original rounded/grid adaptation, not an as-built reconstruction

nativeToWorld.meaning: Signed native local Y is preserved. Deepest plate maps to world h=0; native surface maps to world h=46.64. This is artist binding metadata, not a general terrain/basement implementation.

plan.integration: Artist custom geometry provider. Current axis-aligned world queries cannot represent the curved structure exactly; game query/navigation adoption requires a separate reviewed capability.
